newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM to raise Oct, Nov rubber futures margin fees.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM to raise Oct, Nov rubber futures margin fees.

text.p: The Tokyo Commodity Exchange (TOCOM) said on Monday that it would raise the margin requirements on its October and November rubber futures contracts, effective from Tuesday.
It will raise the margin requirement on the October contract by 20,000 yen per trading lot, bringing the total October requirement to 147,750 yen, TOCOM said.
The margin for the November contract will increase by 10,000 yen per lot to 62,500 yen.
The requirements on other rubber contracts will be unchanged at 52,500 yen, TOCOM said.
